I build and maintain public-interest research infrastructure: trackers, dashboards, directories, and tools that make policy questions easier to monitor, verify, and explain.

These projects are public-facing. I have left out unreleased experiments, internal dashboards, and tools that require private credentials.

## Featured Projects

::: {.project-grid}

::: {.project-card .featured}
### [India Semiconductor Manufacturing Tracker](https://fabs.pranaykotas.com)

::: {.project-meta}
Tracker · Semiconductors · India
:::

An interactive tracker for India's semiconductor manufacturing facilities: fabs, ATMP/OSAT units, compound semiconductor projects, milestones, investment, slippage, and technology complexity.

::: {.project-actions}
[Open tracker](https://fabs.pranaykotas.com){.btn .btn-primary}
[GitHub](https://github.com/pranaykotas/india-semiconductor-tracker){.btn .btn-outline-primary}
:::
:::

## What is not listed here

Some tools are intentionally absent: unreleased games, internal dashboards, private automation scripts, and experiments that are not yet useful for a public visitor. This page is for projects that someone else can open, use, inspect, or build upon.
